    Canonical primitive projectors of a finite linear category #

    The endomorphism algebra of the biproduct of all covariant representables has the evident complete orthogonal idempotents given by its summand projectors. This file matches those projectors with the indecomposable projective labels of an arbitrary finite algebra-module skeleton.
